summary: Two older men from Kansas hiking around Mount Sopris became lost east of Thomas Lakes while trying to get back to their campsite; a 65-year-old called Pitkin County dispatch around 6:30 p.m., and with no cell service the men texted back and forth with four Mountain Rescue Aspen members, who found them in a tent just before midnight near Thomas Lakes; nauseous and thirsty, the pair were escorted back to the trailhead.
notes: KMTS page published 2017-06-21 reporting the rescue as 'last night' (call ~6:30 p.m., found just before midnight); parent-opened live + weekday-verified (Tuesday). Filed under the Sopris Sun chunk: the Sun itself carried no coverage of this 2017 incident; it surfaced in the chunk's thin-year probe searches.
